record.rationale: Task6764KT connects actual registered CSS FontFaces to unique active same-origin CSSOM declarations, preserving ambiguity as unknown rather than selecting guessed glyph data. Source URLs use actual stylesheet bases and CSS string decoding; disabled/opaque/inactive sheets,duplicate descriptors,local/fallback/unsupported format/technology sources are not guessed. FontList retains source URLs, reads only on demand, waits for actual face.load and propagates HTTP/load failures. Chromium witnesses run actual repository exports over production Writer/Calc pages; unit CSSOM descriptor ports explicitly compensate for jsdom dropping font-face-only descriptors and are not native browser evidence. Actual font cmap/capability readers,native regular-face choice and visual font/style dropdown integration remain unfinished; no full parity/default promotion.
responsibilities: Actual active CSSOM font descriptors and one-to-one registered face source matching.
Conservative same-origin source URL resolution without substituting fake glyph or physical metrics.

stackDivergence.rationale: The browser CSSOM and real registered FontFace identity supply source URLs for physical metadata acquisition. Native font/backend tables and cmap behavior remain separate owners; no font support is inferred from browser fallback painting.
